passives.name: Defense System (Error)
passives.description: (Passive Effect)Takes increased damage from Fire-, Water-, and Earth-attribute enemies, and enemies always attack with a favorable attribute. All enemies’ Speed becomes 0, and they are afflicted with Extra Skill Disabled and Extra Turn Disabled (permanent). After your attack, increases all enemies’ Priority by [Buff_V_4086013_4_4] (may be limited to 80% under certain conditions). Damage from Cursed/Fixed Damage cannot exceed [Buff_V_4086013_4_5]/[Buff_V_4086013_4_6] respectively. However, Fixed Damage received from Skill Chains can be up to [Buff_V_4086013_4_7].

passives.name: Challenger's Spirit
passives.description: (Passive Effect)The enemy team gains courage against despair, receiving special effects based on their roles. Striker: +60% Critical Damage to all allies per Striker ally Mage: +[Buff_V_4086013_5_2_1] ATK to all allies per Mage ally Defender: On action, heals all allies by +[Buff_V_4086013_5_4_1] HP Ranger: On action, grants all allies a Barrier for [Buff_T_4086013_5_3_1] turns Healer: On action, reduces the boss’s WG by [Buff_V_4086013_5_5] Enemy team’s Skill Chain damage increases per ally of the same attribute. WG damage taken from Assist and Skill Chains is reduced by 100%.
